# Problem Or Proposal

Describe the behavior, expected result, and why it matters.

## Reproduction

Use fictional data and a minimal configuration. Include relevant application/runtime/browser versions and whether the problem affects chat, voice, administration, or deployment.

## Diagnostics

Include sanitized errors and tests performed. Do not post tokens, connection strings, private profile/knowledge, conversations, or audio. See [security reporting](../SECURITY.md) for sensitive issues.
